notes.title: A Brand-New Visual Update!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re back with some exciting news: [b]Circle Empires 2 just got a major visual update![/b][/p][p]Over the last few months, we’ve been [b]closely[/b] [b]listening to your feedback[/b]. Many of you told us you missed the look and feel of the earlier Circle Empires games, so our art team rolled up their sleeves and got to work. After months of sketching, testing, and refining, we’re proud to introduce the [b]brand-new style for Circle Empires 2![/b][/p][p]This wasn’t a simple task. With the [b]unit editor[/b] allowing for a gazillion combinations, we originally went with a more minimalist character design to keep things manageable. But you asked for units that looked more [b]human-like and closer to the original Circle Empires style, so that’s what we tried to deliver.[/b] The result is a new visual direction that keeps some of the flexibility of custom units while bringing more personality and variation to every soldier, frogman, or vampire you create.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308700/0937448b1fce76fae89fe3334d0c38281b7cddc3.png"][/img][/p][p]You can explore the new art style right now, in [b]our updated demo![/b] But that’s not all!. Alongside the new art style and some fixes, the demo now comes packed with new content to sink your teeth into:[/p][list][*][p][b]New map size[/b] for even more varied conquests[/p][/*][*][p][b]Custom mounted units[/b] (yes, put someone [i]on[/i] something else)[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Monster Hunt game mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh items, buildings, and abilities[/b] to experiment with[/p][/*][*][p][b]Much greater variation of circle guards[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]And much, much [/b][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DlOUWnQm4T02kmZ6QJG4bTpXS3vsTdvy5CPUhyiR0fs/edit?tab=t.0"]more[/url][b].[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]If you haven’t tried the demo yet [i](or if it’s been a while)[/i] now’s the perfect time to jump back in and see all the new stuff for yourself.[/p][p][/p][p]And for those of you who want to be even more involved in the look and feel of Circle Empires 2: we’re also running [url="https://discord.gg/eDVu4p8quF"]another exclusive Beta playtest on our Discord[/url][u][b]![/b][/u] This is your chance to play an early version of the game and directly [b]shape the future of Circle Empires 2 with your feedback & suggestions.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to share your thoughts with us! [b]Every comment & suggestion helps us shape Circle Empires 2 into the best game it can be.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the circles,[/p][p]Luminous[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Thank you for Playing the Demo!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone,[/b]
[/h3][p][/p][p]Just wanted to pop in to give [b]a huge thank you to everyone who played the [i]Circle Empires 2[/i] demo[/b] during Next Fest. And an even bigger thanks to those who [b]shared feedback, left reviews, or just spent a few hours stacking wizards on dragons[/b]. 
[/p][p]We’ve gone through all your comments and suggestions, and we’re already working on implementing some of the most requested changes. We’ll be sharing more on what that looks like soon, [b]so stay tuned![/b]
[/p][p]If you haven’t jumped into the demo yet, good news: [b]it’s still live and will stay up for the foreseeable future.[/b] You can still conquer some circles, test out the new mounting system, and battle for a spot on the in-game [b]daily challenge leaderboard.[/b]
[/p][p]We’ve loved seeing how you play, what you break, and how you adapt to this new version of circular chaos. [b]More updates soon. We’re just getting started.[/b]
[/p][p]Thanks again,[/p][p][b]Team Luminous[/b][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093020/Circle_Empires_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play Circle Empires 2 during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]How’s the demo treating you so far?[/b] Figured out how to stack a vampire on a bear yet?
[/p][p]In case you missed it: [b]the [i]Circle Empires 2[/i] demo is live now as part of Steam Next Fest![/b] It’s our first public look at the game, and gives you a taste of the new systems, unit editor, and circle-crushing chaos we’ve been cooking up. If you want a full breakdown of what’s in the demo, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3093020/view/534352273139042505"]check out Friday’s blog. [/url][/p][previewyoutube="aUf7XLJElkE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Getting this demo out has been [b]an important milestone for us[/b], and we’ve absolutely loved reading your feedback so far. If you’ve left a review, thank you! [b]Every single one helps more players discover the game[/b], and your thoughts are gonna be useful in shaping where we take things next. [/p][p][b]If you haven’t left a review yet and you’re enjoying the game, Steam Next Fest is the perfect time to do it.[/b] It helps a ton with visibility and lets us know what’s working (and what’s hilariously broken).
[/p][p]We’ve got more updates to come, but for now: have fun with the demo, let us know how it goes, and enjoy the rest of Next Fest!
[/p][p]Luminous
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645370/Circle_Empires_2_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: The Circle Empires 2 Demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone,[/h2][p][/p][h3]We’re back, and this time [i]you[/i] get to step into the circle![/h3][h3][b]The Circle Empires 2 demo is out now![/b] 
[/h3][p][/p][p]Check out our brand-new [b]demo trailer[/b] to see what we have in store:
[/p][previewyoutube="aUf7XLJElkE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This sequel [b]builds on the strongest aspects of the previous games and adds huge amounts of freedom.[/b] On top of the [b]fast-paced conquest, powerful units, and of course, gorgeous smooth circles[/b], you can [b]design your own units![/b][/p][p][b]The unit designer[/b] allows you to select a base creature (human, ghost, frogman, vampire etc) and equip it with weapons and armor. Each creature and piece of equipment has [b]unique advantages and drawbacks.[/b] Mermaids swim well, but frogmen move faster on land. Want to not die? Wear a helmet! Now you’ll need gold to buy that unit, though. Want to not take an arrow in the knee? Use a shield! But now it's more difficult to attack the enemies... [/p][p]Sometimes, unarmored guys with clubs are the best solution; sometimes, a vampire in full kit with a huge shield wielding a crossbow is needed for the job. [/p][p][b]The aim is always to make equipment choices situational without a clear best pick.[/b]
[/p][p]The landscape system has also been completely revised. You can combine layers of walls, moats, and natural obstacles to create impenetrable fortresses. Necromancer Towers freeze the land, making it unsuitable for farming. Enough catapult fire can turn beautiful grassland to desert. Water holes are great for agriculture, but really bad for worker movement – unless you plan your layout carefully (or create workers that can swim). 
[/p][p][b]Both the unit editor and landscape granularity are planned to be expanded heavily.[/b] We're going to put units on top of each other, allowing mounted units in the unit editor, custom-made towers, and new base creatures, weapons & terrain types.[/p][p]In this demo, you’ll get to play as [b]4 different leaders[/b] with unique unit selections. Explore the [i]Full Conquest[/i] and [i]Daily Challenge[/i] game modes and tweak your games with [b]a handful of map sizes and difficulty settings – both in single and multiplayer! [/b][/p][p]This is our first public slice of Circle Empires 2. We’re beyond excited to get to share it with you, and we can’t wait to hear what you all think. [b]As always, if you have questions, comments and concerns, please leave a review on our Demo page![/b] It’s the easiest way to help us get the demo in front of as many eyes as possible. 
[/p][p]Thank you once again for all your support, and go conquer some circles![/p][p]Luminous [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645370/Circle_Empires_2_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Circle Empires 2: Demo out on June 6th!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

We’ve been counting the days, and now it’s official: [b]the first public demo of Circle Empires 2 goes live on June 6th as part of Steam Next Fest![/b] 🎉

This is a huge moment for us! It’s the first time the game is out in the wild for everyone to try. Whether you’re here for the chaotic conquests, the competitive streak, or just to see what we’ve been quietly cooking up… we can’t wait to hear what you think.

So what’s in the demo?

You’ll get access to both [b]singleplayer and multiplayer[/b] (including LAN and dedicated servers!). Four unique leaders are ready to command, each with their own twist, from the icy resolve of [i]Wiz the Wizzrd[/i] to the undead experiments of [i]Nethier the Necromancer[/i].

We’ve also packed in [b]two game modes[/b]: a classic full conquest experience and a prototype of our upcoming Daily Challenges. You’ll be able to tweak difficulty, map size, modifiers, and try out a [b]variety of races, mounts, weapons, and structures[/b] to get a real feel for this worthy sequel!

It’s just a slice of what’s to come, but there’s a lot to sink your teeth into. We’ll be keeping an eye out during Next Fest to chat & collect feedback! So make sure to drop any feedback you have – whether it’s positive or negative – right here on Steam or over on our Discord.

[b]June 6th. Wishlist the game. Play the demo. Tell us everything.[/b]

Got it?

See you soon,
Luminous

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645370/Circle_Empires_2_Demo/

We’re still keeping things under wraps, but [b]keep an eye on our blogs to find out more in the coming weeks.[/b]

Luminous

notes.title: Circle Empires 2: Addressing Your Burning Questions!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

A few weeks ago, we announced the next title in the Circle Empires series: Circle Empires 2! We were thrilled by your enthusiasm, but we also saw some questions that popped up over and over again. So we figured it would make sense to address all of your burning questions in a Steam blog. So without further ado: welcome to the very first FAQ blog for Circle Empires 2!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h5][b]Wait? RIVALS is not CE2!?[/b][/h5]

Yep, this is Circle Empires 2 – says it right on the tin!

[h5][b]What will be different (in a nutshell)?[/b][/h5]

With Circle Empires 2, the goal is to create a concentrated experience. Less stuff, but more meaningful variation. You now have to study less and experiment more. Big changes to core systems like unit & terrain interactions, and unit behaviour will completely upset how the game feels. Many new systems just weren’t possible in the old engine and we had to completely rewrite things from scratch.

You now have granular control over terrain and building placements. You can balance the maze-like defensive plans of the circle with optimal economic layouts. Units can push each other, leading to group vs. group struggles in key areas, which you can manipulate with your defensive layouts, magic units, and positioning. Any unit can ride any other unit that is large enough. Want to employ the dragon as a mount for a worker? Can do. Just lots of cool stuff that wasn't possible before.

[h5][u][b]What’s your favourite unit and why?[/b][/u][/h5]

I like the pike man, because he lets you easily hold your position and, with sufficient numbers, keep enemies at bay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308700/ed884e6eefb84c7e4d30c73e3e336f5afaf04860.png[/img]
Also: [i][b]FOR SPARTAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA![/b][/i]

[h5][u][b]Are there any single-player game modes?[/b][/u][/h5]

Yeah you SP lovers, we got you. No worries. Though we’re still actively considering which game modes will be brought over, there will be an active single player mode. So, let us know which ones you like the most so we can make sure that those are considered!

[h5][u][b]Will it have multiplayer?[/b][/u][/h5]

MP lovers, of course we’ve got your backs too. CE2 will have multiplayer from the get-go, and we’ll be actively testing the multiplayer mode until launch. So if you want to get an early taste, wishlist the game and keep an eye on Playtest sign-up becoming available!

[h5][u][b]This is CIRCLE Empires! Why are the platforms not circles!?[/b][/u][/h5]

The landscape in CE2 is now built from grids, which, indeed, makes it less… well, circular. 

But they’re still very much circles! They’re just made from squares. I guess Square-Circle Empires just didn’t have the same ring to it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308700/87255c92e831b59302eda9d21e9232f5b4281209.png[/img]
However, this new grid layout allows us to do the following two things:

[olist]
[*] Players can create terrain layouts in their circles using water, desert, grass, and other terrain types to optimize their defense and economy. There is often a tradeoff between what is best economically versus what makes the circle easy to defend.
[*] Having circles made of grids allows us to create more variation in circle layouts. In the future, it may be possible to extend that further if modding becomes a thing.[/olist]
[h5][u][b]Why the new unit design?[/b][/u][/h5]

We totally recognize that the art style in previous Circle Empires games has its own charm and many people will miss that. I will also miss parts of it. 

From a game dev standpoint, however, the new, more blob-like characters can be easily assembled from several pieces, giving us a lot more flexibility. 

For example, the sword-and-shield guy has body, face, shield, and sword. Each of these can function separately:
[list]
[*] The body can be knocked over so they are on the ground (downed)
[*] The face is more expressive. The character can be surprised when attacked, angry when looking for a fight, and happy after winning or completing a task.
[*] The sword and shield are flung off when the unit dies.[/list]
This modularity allows us to experiment with unit types, because individual parts can be swapped around. For example, we could make a unit with spear and shield, by switching out the sword for a spear. This component-based system opens up new visual effects and mechanics.

The animations are also a looooot smoother. The old sprites were animated frame-by-frame making them a bit choppy from time to time. It's perhaps not super clear from the videos, but the animations in CE2 are much smoother at high frame rates. It's also easier for us to add different animations. For example, when you win a battle, all units will have a cheering animation where they wave their weapons around and smile. It would be very hard to hand-draw that for every unit type. Streamlining allows us to spend the more time on other cool stuff. 

[h5][u][b]Facial Expressions?!?!?![/b][/u][/h5]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308700/a08d77e40573bb4c39154a8608b5918a4bc6f13d.png[/img]
Facial expressions.

[h5][u][b]Q: Favourite circular food?[/b][/u][/h5]

It’s round, it’s sweet, and always steals the spotlight—until you bite into the pit and it fights back. Cherries are the best.

[h5][u][b]Will I be able to make crazy mods? [/b][/u][/h5]

There probably won’t be official mod support at launch, but we might implement it at a later stage. At this point, we can’t guarantee modding, but we’ll keep it in mind!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093020/Circle_Empires_2/

notes.title: Circle Empires 2: A Letter from the Dev!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone, [/h3]

The wait is finally over, and we’re over the moon to announce the long-awaited next entry in the Circle Empires series. [b]This is Circle Empires 2![/b]

[previewyoutube=TeruSM_eeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

This game is a [b]huge step[/b] for us, because we’ve approached things a little differently. As you can already tell from the screenshots, [b]we’ve built a sequel that looks and feels a little different[/b], while still [b]maintaining the core values of what we all love about the Circle Empires series[/b]. 

Circle Empires 2 will offer you a uniquely engaging experience, whether you’re a seasoned veteran of circular warfare or a rookie:

[b]For old players:[/b] CE2 is completely rebuilt with new core structures. This unlocks lots of cool stuff that wasn't technically possible before. You now have granular control over terrain and building placements. You can balance the maze-like defensive plans of the circle with optimal economic layouts. Units can push each other, leading to group vs group struggles in key areas, which you can manipulate with your defensive layouts, magic units and positioning. Any unit can ride any other unit that is large enough. Want to employ the dragon as a mount for a worker? Can do. Just lots of cool stuff that wasn't possible before. 

[b]For new players:[/b] CE2 is an extremely easy to learn strategy game where you conquer, develop and defend small kingdoms in deeply varying circumstances. Fight detailed, tragic battles, defend or sacrifice regions and develop the smartest route to domination in every situation. Start out easy and improve until you master the Impossible.

So, as you can see, we really meant it when we put that little “2” in the title. This is a game that builds on the DNA of Circle Empires, CE: Rivals, and CE: Tactics, while [b]going [i]beyond[/i].[/b]

A clean slate allows us to make big changes. With Circle Empires 2, the goal is to create a concentrated experience. Less stuff but more meaningful variation. You now have to [b]study less and experiment more[/b]. Big changes to core systems like unit interactions, terrain interactions and unit AI will completely upset how the game feels and is balanced. Many new systems are not possible in the old engine and have required a complete rewrite from scratch.

There’s still a long way to go before we can give you a chance to experience Circle Empires 2 for yourselves. Right now, the single player is working with minimalistic content and multiplayer is taking shape. Much of the content is to be added still, but we’re passionately working away and [b]we cannot wait to show you more of our little world full of rotund battlefields. [/b]

Can’t wait to hear what you all think.

Luminous

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093020/Circle_Empires_2/

notes.title: Circle Empires 2 - Coming Whenever
notes.content:
[h3]We’re back and we’re going full circle! Today, Luminous and Iceberg Interactive are incredibly excited to reveal that we’ve been working on Circle Empires 2!
[/h3]

[h5]Watch the reveal trailer right here:[/h5]

[previewyoutube=TeruSM_eeWo;full][/previewyoutube]

This direct sequel will make the indie smash hit [i]bigger and better than ever[/i]. Still, we tried to maintain the approachability and simplicity of the previous games’ unique take on the RTS genre, which we’ve always seen as the core of the franchise. 

Circle Empires 2 takes everything you love about the original game and sequel and [b]adds even more strategic depth, variety, and fun. We've introduced new units, weapons, and terrain effects[/b] to keep you coming round for more. There’s also a brand-new mounting system that lets any unit ride another larger one. Want to put a necromancer on a dragon? Go for it! 

As we keep working on the game, we’ll need some [u]playtesters[/u] to figure out what works and what doesn’t. So, wishlist Circle Empires 2 to not miss out on the chance to help us test the game early!
